nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza A and RSV are in “High” category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in “Medium” category. The other respiratory viruses (Influenza B, HMPV, and EV-D68) remain in “Low” wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/ysGVWpi7gz

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the “Medium” category with medium concentrations and no significant trend up or down over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/Ui3MXpFONN

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (36.6%) and KP.3 variant in light blue (29.4%) make up approximately 66% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/mUXamuxNGK

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the “High” category with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in the “Low” category nationally, but in the high category in the West and Northeast. https://t.co/gyL8uBB6fp

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 detected in 24 states since monitoring began - 5 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 6 in the South, and 6 in the Northeast. As of 3/12/25, 17 of these states reported infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections in CA, KY, MN, NH, NJ, VT, & UT. https://t.co/6JhmSn5Kg6

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and no significant trend up or down over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/TetgjlGoyK

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HPMV: HMPV is in the “Low” category nationally, but is in onset and in the “High” category in most regions (West, Midwest, and Northeast). https://t.co/IeDC6s53me

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions remain in the “High” category. https://t.co/8o8fFBjTGm
